_what: Every exec sentinel accounted for: reads_exit_code (branch acts on the code), fire_and_forget (handled, ack deliberately ignored - reason given), fired_no_handler (sent, never dispatched - reason given), todo (stage-2 work queue: classify or justify). test_exec_branch_accounting.py keeps this file and the code from drifting apart.

reads_exit_code.MPRIS_START: nonzero exit stops the dead daemon's write/poll churn
reads_exit_code.DL_YTDLP: mutagen-only failure retries without embedding; 0 confirms the file

fire_and_forget.PW_UNCOMBINE: teardown; the sweep that follows is the real check
fire_and_forget.PW_COMBINE_CLEAN: cleanup of a body already abandoned
fire_and_forget.PW_TRIM: balance nudge; the next verify measures the truth
fire_and_forget.PW_CALIBKILL: kills a wedged calibration; nothing to report
fire_and_forget.PW_DRIFTKILL: kills a wedged drift probe; nothing to report
fire_and_forget.PW_ORPHANS: orphan sweep; absence of orphans is normal

fired_no_handler.ALARM_UNMUTE: alarm must sound; unmute is best effort on top
fired_no_handler.BT_GENTLE: polite disconnect attempt before the kick
fired_no_handler.PW_FLUSH: sink flush before rebuild, best effort
fired_no_handler.PW_MASTERLIFT: master lift is re-measured by the next verify
fired_no_handler.PW_UNMUTE: unmute on volume raise; the slider state is the truth
fired_no_handler.REC_STOP: recording stop; the file's size is the verdict
